parsed.outcome: Water-service access and supply, including infrastructure availability, supply-demand balance, affordability, service provision, and reliability
parsed.rationale: The Introduction and Discussion examine rural household and community water-supply access in relation to legal and institutional barriers, government programs, regulation, financing, and community-management arrangements. The Methodology, Sources of data, and Results sections identify a PRISMA-guided review design, database searches, eligibility procedures, and a final sample of 36 documents, while reporting access-related findings such as service coverage, supply-system availability, and affordability constraints. Although the review methods and source selection appear weak and heterogeneous, it contains an identifiable systematic synthesis relevant to the mechanism review.
